  • Enum Constant Details

    • LAUNCH

      public static final FlightEvent.Type LAUNCH
      Rocket launch.

    • IGNITION

      public static final FlightEvent.Type IGNITION
      Ignition of a motor. Source is the motor mount the motor of which has ignited, and the data is the MotorId of the motor instance.

    • LIFTOFF

      public static final FlightEvent.Type LIFTOFF
      When the motor has lifted off the ground.

    • LAUNCHROD

      public static final FlightEvent.Type LAUNCHROD
      Launch rod has been cleared.

    • BURNOUT

      public static final FlightEvent.Type BURNOUT
      Burnout of a motor. Source is the motor mount the motor of which has burnt out, and the data is the MotorId of the motor instance.

    • EJECTION_CHARGE

      public static final FlightEvent.Type EJECTION_CHARGE
      Ejection charge of a motor fired. Source is the motor mount the motor of which has exploded its ejection charge, and data is the MotorId of the motor instance.

    • STAGE_SEPARATION

      public static final FlightEvent.Type STAGE_SEPARATION
      Separation of a stage. Source is the stage which is being separated from the upper stages.

    • APOGEE

      public static final FlightEvent.Type APOGEE
      Apogee has been reached.

    • RECOVERY_DEVICE_DEPLOYMENT

      public static final FlightEvent.Type RECOVERY_DEVICE_DEPLOYMENT
      Opening of a recovery device. Source is the RecoveryComponent which has opened.

    • GROUND_HIT

      public static final FlightEvent.Type GROUND_HIT
      Ground has been hit after flight.

    • SIMULATION_END

      public static final FlightEvent.Type SIMULATION_END
      End of simulation. Placing this to the queue will end the simulation.

    • ALTITUDE

      public static final FlightEvent.Type ALTITUDE
      A change in altitude has occurred. Data is a Pair<Double, Double> which contains the old and new altitudes.

    • TUMBLE

      public static final FlightEvent.Type TUMBLE
      The rocket begins to tumble.
